newsitem.title: USA: Unifi, Parkdale Mills in spun yarn venture.
newsitem.headline: Unifi, Parkdale Mills in spun yarn venture.

text.p: Unifi Inc and Parkdale Mills Inc said Tuesday they agreed to form a joint venture combining Unifi's spun yarn assets with certain spun yarn assets of Parkdale.

In a joint statement, the companies said Parkdale would be majority owner and manage day-to-day operations of the venture, which will operate the companies' open end and air jet spinning assets. Yarns produced by the venture will be sold under the Parkdale brand, they said.
The companies said the plan is subject to execution of a definitive agreement and an operating agreement as well as various corporate approvals.
